goal: +4 to Melee Skills, T1 Spirit and a free Spirit Skill from the Amulet base!
name: Absent Ammy Craft

steps.title: Get an Absent Amulet (Item level 75+)
steps.detail: This Amulet is obtained from the Genesis Tree using the Endgame Breach mechanic, or by Using the in-game Trade Market. You will want to make sure the Item Level is at-least 75 to ensure you can get all the desired modifiers at their highest value).

items.name: Chaos Orb
items.description: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new random modifier

steps.title: Use Chaos Orbs until you hit Tier 1 Spirit.
steps.detail: Use as many Chaos Orbs as it takes until you see Tier 1 Spirit modifier.

items.name: Exalted Orb
items.description: Augments a Rare item with a new random modifier

items.name: Exalted Orb
items.description: Augments a Rare item with a new random modifier

steps.title: Use 2 Exalted Orbs.
steps.detail: You want to use 2 exalted orbs to make the Absent Amulet have 3 modifiers in total. Tier 1 Spirit and any two additional modifiers.

items.name: Preserved Collarbone
items.description: Desecrates a Rare Amulet, Ring or Belt

steps.title: Use a Preserved Collarbone.
steps.detail: Use this desecrated currency on your Absent Amulet to add an unveiled desecrated modifier. This helps your odds of not ruining the Amulet craft for the next step by increasing your odds to succeed.

items.name: Fracturing Orb
items.description: Fracture a random modifier on a rare item with at least 4 modifiers, locking it in place.

steps.title: Use a Fracturing Orb on the Amulet!
steps.detail: The reason we used the collarbone in the previous step is because the Fracturing Orb needs 4 modifiers on a rare item to work, but a desecrated modifier cannot be Fractured! This means you have a 33% chance to Fracture the right modifier (Tier 1 Spirit), instead of 25% chance if you had 4 regular modifiers.

branches.text: Restart the craft with a new base. RNG didn't go your way and you will save more currency by starting over.
Use 2 Orbs of Annulment until you have the fractured modifier (Tier 1 Spirit) and 1 other modifier (doesn't matter what it is).

items.name: Orb of Annulment
items.description: Removes a random modifier from an item

items.name: Essence of the Breach
items.description: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier

steps.title: Use Essence of the Breach for +20% Quality.
steps.detail: Because we Fractured Tier 1 spirit, the remaining modifier will be removed to improve the Quality of this Amulet, which helps us push the +3 Melee Skills -> +4. This is how we get such a high quality!

items.name: Reaver Catalyst
items.description:
Adds quality that enhances Attack modifiers on a ring or amulet
Replaces other quality types

steps.title: Use Reaver Catalyst until 40% Quality.
steps.detail: You will need to use as many Reaver Catalysts as it takes to push this Quality all the way up until it hits 40%. Reaver is the Attack Catalyst and will increase the power of any "Attack" modifiers on the item.

items.description: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new random modifier

steps.title: Chaos Orb spam until +3 Melee Skills modifier.
steps.detail: This is pure RNG and may take several Chaos Orbs. May RNGesus be with you!

targets.text: +# to Level of all Melee Skills

steps.title: Exalted orb a second prefix with Omen of Sinistral Exaltation.
steps.detail: Activate the Omen of Sinistral Exaltation by right clicking it in your inventory, then use the Exalted Orb. This Omen forces the Exalted Orb to only add Prefix Modifiers.

steps.detail: Activate the Omen of Sinistral Crystallisation in your inventory then use the Perfect Essence of Enhancement. This forces the Essence to eat the random modifier we got from the Prefix side of the Amulet thanks to Omen of Sinistral Exaltation.

branches.text: Use Omen of Light + Orb of Annulment to remove the unwanted modifier. Then use Omen of Abyssal Echoes with a new Ancient Collarbone to reveal 6 more modifiers until you're happy with your Critical Hit Chance modifier.
